headline: Sell the ANET tail and trim DLR to fund Nubank and more Lilly — core untouched.
approach: Funding comes only from the two things the plan can spare: the sub-2% ANET tail and a DLR trim, because NVDA, AVGO and VRT are core and never sold on price. Cash lands before it goes out at every step, so no buy ever front-runs its funding sale. Compute Power gets fixed through DLR since VRT was just added to and cannot be touched.
first_move: Sell all $150 of ANET at market today.

steps.sell: Sell all $150 of ANET at market.
steps.why: Clears a sub-2% tail position as the plan directs, which overrides my standing HOLD call on ANET.
steps.realizes: Books a tiny short-term loss that offsets gains; do not rebuy ANET for 30 days.

steps.trigger: ANET proceeds settle in the account.
steps.why: Opens Financials, the only theme you own none of, using the $150 sale plus your $210 cash.
steps.realizes: No tax event on a purchase.

steps.trigger: DLR recovers its small loss and trades back at breakeven.
steps.why: Cuts Compute Power toward target since VRT cannot be sold, and this overrides my standing HOLD on DLR.
steps.realizes: Books a small short-term loss usable against gains; do not rebuy DLR for 30 days.

steps.trigger: Step 3 fills and LLY still trades near $1,226.54.
steps.sell: Trim the last $233 of DLR at market.
steps.why: Finishes the Compute Power cut and builds Healthcare, your largest gap, into your second engine.
steps.realizes: Books the rest of the DLR loss against gains; the 30-day rebuy clock stays in force.

steps.trigger: Your next cash contribution lands in the account.
steps.why: Completes the 5% Financials sleeve with new money rather than selling a core name to get there.
steps.realizes: No tax event on a purchase.

guardrails: Stop all buying for two weeks if the book falls below $8,200.
Cancel a sale if the news is only a price drop — core names go only on broken business news.
Do not rebuy ANET or DLR within 30 days, or the tax loss is disallowed.
Keep the speculative sleeve under 8% and set every stop before entry, never after.

tax.detail: Selling books a loss you can use to offset gains — short-term, which offsets the most expensive gains first. Don't rebuy within 30 days or the loss is disallowed.

governance.thesis: Own a concentrated core of AI compute, data-center power and one great healthcare compounder, bought on weakness and held for years, funded by cutting the sub-2% tail positions rather than adding new cash, with a capped speculative sleeve for the asymmetric shot.
guardrails: No single position above 18% of the book; top five stay under 60%.
Speculative sleeve capped at 8% total, each pick near 3%, never averaged down.
Every speculative buy gets a stop set before entry — SMCI stop $21.
Core names are sold only on broken business news, never on a falling price.
If the book drops below $8,200, pause all new buying for two weeks.
long_term: Core to hold for years: NVDA, AVGO, VRT, GOOGL, MSFT — add on weakness, never sell on price.
LLY is your second engine: 2026 guidance raised to $82-85B and a newly approved weight-loss pill.
Shrink from 15 positions to 8-10 so your best ideas actually move the account.
Keep the power sleeve near 12% through CEG, down 20% this year while signing data-center contracts.
Add Financials — a theme you don't own — only via NU near $14.62, for its fast-growing digital bank.
Hold winners past one year; this year's booked losses offset gains you do take.
